name: ELDEN RING

antiCheat.name: Easy Anti-Cheat
antiCheat.note: Mods load through me3, which starts the game offline without its anti-cheat.

notes: Steam 1245620. Nexus domain eldenring. Saves: AppData/Roaming/EldenRing/<steam id>/ER0000.sl2 (Seamless Co-op: .co2).

me3 v0.13.0 (github.com/garyttierney/me3, releases 2026-08-11) starts Game/eldenring.exe directly, without the anti-cheat starter, with mods from a Turbine-owned profile; nothing is placed in the game folder. Recheck on the device before shipping.
